title: Feeling jittery today?
caption: Feeling jittery today? It’s a bouncy day—energy can spike and then dip. Keep tasks bite-size, add brief slow-breathing breaks between steps, and move light to steady your pace.
snapshot: Geomagnetic conditions shifted into a more active state with a strong southward tilt. Solar wind speed remains in a normal band. No notable flares. Multiple solar eruptions were seen lately without evidence aimed at Earth.
affects: A wired-and-tired pattern can crop up, where you feel keyed up and then unexpectedly drained. Restlessness, fidgeting, and a quicker startle can ride along. Focus may be choppy when the body feels revved.
playbook:
- Insert brief slow-breathing breaks between tasks
- Keep efforts bite-sized and move lightly
- Step outside for a few minutes of daylight
- Drink water and ease late caffeine
